title: Shelfshare
tagline: An invite-only lending library for friends: scan your shelves, borrow instead of buy.
description: A closed-community library where friends share their personal bookshelves, search everyone's books at once and request to borrow, with barcode scanning on phones.
longDescription:
Shelfshare lets a circle of friends pool their bookshelves. Search once across everyone's books and the result tells you whether you own it, which friend has a copy, or that nobody has it yet. Then request to borrow, and the owner approves or declines on their Requests tab.

- **Add books by barcode.** The phone camera uses the native `BarcodeDetector` on Android Chrome and falls back to `html5-qrcode` on iOS. ISBNs are looked up in Open Library, then Google Books.
- **Invite-only groups.** Sign-up needs a single-use invite code tied to a group, such as a book club or family. You only see books from people who share a group with you.
- **Safe by default.** Every API needs a login, passwords are hashed, and startup migrations are additive and idempotent, so no data is ever dropped.

It's built on Flask and SQLite with a single static page styled like a classic lending library: parchment, card-catalogue results and brass drawer tabs, and it works on phones.

tourSteps.title: One search across every shelf
tourSteps.body: Search by title, author or ISBN. Each result says whether you own it, which friend has a copy, or that nobody has it yet.

tourSteps.title: Request to borrow
tourSteps.body: The request is logged and the owner marks it OK or NO on their Requests tab.

tourSteps.title: Add books with your phone camera
tourSteps.body: Scan a barcode and the ISBN is looked up in Open Library, then Google Books. You can also type an ISBN or add a book by hand.

tourSteps.title: Invite-only circles
tourSteps.body: Generate single-use invite codes for a group. You only see books from people who share a group with you.
